raw_question: Using only Hansen lossyear codes 1 through 23 (calendar years 2001 through 2023) inside this AOI, compute each year's grid-aware loss area in hectares and return the year with the largest area plus that six-decimal area. Break an equal six-decimal area tie in favor of the earliest year. If no valid pixel has a code from 1 through 23, return year 'no_loss' and loss_ha 0.0. Code 0 is valid no-loss and nodata 255 is excluded.
question:
Using only Hansen lossyear codes 1 through 23 (calendar years 2001 through 2023) inside this AOI, compute each year's grid-aware loss area in hectares and return the year with the largest area plus that six-decimal area.
